title: Identifying the clarinet players: Bundy, Frank Crump, Howard Davis
summary: Paul names clarinetists including Israel Gorman, Willie Humphrey, Bundy (now a cab driver), Frank Crump and Howard Davis, and a trumpeter who worked with him at the Y.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals
